deadline.value: Fall priority deadline is January 31 for admission; Priority 2 is April 15. The page gives no department-specific deadline.

gre_general.value: Department catalog minimum for the PhD is 292 quantitative plus verbal and 2.5 analytical writing.

gre_subject.value: No official page mentions a subject GRE test for this field.

toefl_min.value: Department catalog minimum is TOEFL iBT 80 (internet-based) or 213 (computer-based).

supervisor.value: No official page says a supervisor must be agreed before admission.

funding.value: Departmental funding goes to a limited number of applicants at admission, per the Graduate College.
funding.quote: Departmental funding is awarded to a limited number of highly qualified, full-time students at the time of admission.

entry_route.value: The catalog does not say whether a bachelor's or master's is needed for the PhD.

notes: One record covers the Civil Engineering and Environmental Engineering PhDs in CAEE; the Architectural Engineering PhD is outside the field list and is not saved.
name: Civil and Environmental Engineering (Ph.D.)
